entries.name: Due to maintenance of the DOTA2 Arcade system, you cannot launch games inside DOTA2 for now.
Download the Xiaoheihe PC client.
entries.detail: Open https://dota.xiaoheihe.cn/ in your system browser. The built-in Dota 2 browser may fail.

entries.name: If you cannot register within the app, complete quick registration on the Xiaoheihe site.
If you cannot see any model in recruit panel, pls enhance your dota2 video settings slightly.
entries.detail: If you cannot see any model in recruit panel, pls enhance your dota2 video settings slightly.
